_comment: One entry per image file in this folder. Every field is optional and an image with no entry still renders. alt = what a screen reader says. who = the line under it; leave it out when you genuinely do not know. note = one line on what it shows. Each of the three takes either a plain string or {he,en,nl}, because the screenshots are Hebrew and the caption is the only thing that carries them into the other two languages. wide = true for a photograph of a room, which gets the site's grayscale; leave it off for screenshots, which stay in colour.

note.he: 26 באוגוסט 2026. "יש הצעה! היא תשלח לי תיכף פרטים"
note.en: 26 August 2026. "There's an offer! She'll send me the details in a moment"
note.nl: 26 augustus 2026. "Er is een aanbod! Ze stuurt me zo de details"

note.he: "אתמול בשעה טובה חתמתי חוזה. התהליך איתך עשה לי סדר בראש, מהדבר הכי בסיסי ועד הכי מהותי"
note.en: "Yesterday, at long last, I signed a contract. The process with you put my head in order, from the most basic thing to the most essential"
note.nl: "Gisteren heb ik eindelijk een contract getekend. Het traject met jou bracht orde in mijn hoofd, van het meest basale tot het meest wezenlijke"
